parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit; a retry reuses it, a new user action mints a new one) that makes a retried request safe (ADR 0018, REST guideline section 2): 1-128 printable ASCII characters. Postgres is the only runtime, so the check is on in every deployment: a missing key is answered with 400 `idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one with 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`; a replay with the same key and the same method, path and body returns the original response plus `Idempotency-Replayed: true`, while the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`.
